title_en: The Cat and the Robot Vacuum
description_ru: Забавная история о коте, который объявил войну новому пылесосу, а потом нашёл ему неожиданное применение.
text:
When Nina bought a robot vacuum cleaner, she expected a quiet life. She did not expect a war.

Her cat, Mr Whiskers, had ruled the apartment for six years. He slept where he wanted, ate when he wanted and ignored everyone who disagreed. On the first morning, the little round machine rolled out of the corner and began to hum. Mr Whiskers sat up, stared at it for a long time, and hissed.

The robot did not care. It simply bumped gently into his tail and carried on cleaning. The cat jumped onto the sofa and watched from above like an angry king.

For three days, he tried everything. He attacked the robot from behind. He hid under the table and jumped out. He even sat in its path and refused to move, but the machine politely turned around and went the other way. "It has no respect," Nina heard him complain, in his own way.

On the fourth day, something changed. Nina found the robot slowly driving around the kitchen with Mr Whiskers sitting calmly on top, like a captain on a ship. His eyes were half closed and his tail swung happily from side to side.

"If you cannot beat them, join them," said Nina, taking a photo.

Now every afternoon the cat enjoys a free ride around the apartment. He has even started to meow at the front door whenever the battery runs low. Apparently, he has become very responsible about it.
